## Notes

Developer Amccus (Pack-In-Soft team of 8-10), Super Famicom Japan 1996-08-09 as Bokujo Monogatari; daily watering, livestock care rules, bar open after dark, wife added as a goal; director Yasuhiro Wada's three principles.
